an5.146:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto na sevitabbo
an5.146:1.3: kammantaṃ kāreti adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti dīghacārikaṃ avatthānacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati na paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ
an5.146:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto na sevitabbo.
an5.146:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo
an5.146:2.3: na kammantaṃ kāreti na adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati na pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti na dīghacārikaṃ avatthānacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ
an5.146:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabboti.
